SELECT season.season_id, season.season_name, season.start_date, season.end_date, season.league_id 
FROM season 
WHERE season.season_id = ?

SELECT league.league_id, league.league_name, league.country, league.sport_id 
FROM league 
WHERE league.league_id = ?

SELECT team.team_id, team.team_name, team.city, team.league_id 
FROM team JOIN roster ON team.team_id = roster.team_id 
WHERE roster.season_id = ? ORDER BY team.team_name, team.team_id

SELECT athlete.athlete_id, athlete.first_name, athlete.last_name, athlete.nationality, team.team_name, membership.position 
FROM athlete JOIN membership ON membership.athlete_id = athlete.athlete_id JOIN roster ON roster.roster_id = membership.roster_id JOIN team ON team.team_id = roster.team_id 
WHERE roster.season_id = ? ORDER BY athlete.last_name, athlete.first_name, athlete.athlete_id

SELECT stat_definition.stat_definition_id, stat_definition.stat_name, stat_definition.abbreviation, stat_definition.calc_type, stat_definition.sport_id, anon_1.subject_id, count(*) AS count_1, CASE WHEN (stat_definition.calc_type = ?) THEN sum(anon_1.stat_value) WHEN (stat_definition.calc_type = ?) THEN avg(anon_1.stat_value) WHEN (stat_definition.calc_type = ?) THEN min(anon_1.stat_value) WHEN (stat_definition.calc_type = ?) THEN max(anon_1.stat_value) WHEN (stat_definition.calc_type = ?) THEN max(CASE WHEN (anon_1.recency = ?) THEN anon_1.stat_value END) END AS anon_2 
FROM stat_definition JOIN (SELECT performance_statistic.team_id AS subject_id, performance_statistic.stat_definition_id AS stat_definition_id, performance_statistic.stat_value AS stat_value, game.game_id AS game_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY performance_statistic.team_id, performance_statistic.stat_definition_id ORDER BY game.game_time DESC, game.game_id DESC, performance_statistic.performance_statistic_id DESC) AS recency 
FROM performance_statistic JOIN game ON game.game_id = performance_statistic.game_id 
WHERE performance_statistic.team_id IN (?, ?) AND game.season_id = ? AND game.status = ?) AS anon_1 ON anon_1.stat_definition_id = stat_definition.stat_definition_id GROUP BY stat_definition.stat_definition_id, stat_definition.stat_name, stat_definition.abbreviation, stat_definition.calc_type, stat_definition.sport_id, anon_1.subject_id ORDER BY stat_definition.stat_name, stat_definition.stat_definition_id

SELECT anon_1.subject_id, count(DISTINCT anon_1.game_id) AS count_1 
FROM (SELECT performance_statistic.team_id AS subject_id, performance_statistic.stat_definition_id AS stat_definition_id, performance_statistic.stat_value AS stat_value, game.game_id AS game_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY performance_statistic.team_id, performance_statistic.stat_definition_id ORDER BY game.game_time DESC, game.game_id DESC, performance_statistic.performance_statistic_id DESC) AS recency 
FROM performance_statistic JOIN game ON game.game_id = performance_statistic.game_id 
WHERE performance_statistic.team_id IN (?, ?) AND game.season_id = ? AND game.status = ?) AS anon_1 GROUP BY anon_1.subject_id
